activity.notes: The Swiss Diet elected Guillaume Henri Dufour General and commander-in-chief on 21 October 1847 for the Sonderbund War. The Swiss office of General is an exceptional wartime supreme command, so ATLAS records each separate election rather than treating it as a continuous rank.

sources.title: Guillaume Henri Dufour (1787–1875) — Swiss Armed Forces
sources.citation_text: The Swiss Armed Forces states that Dufour was appointed commander-in-chief with the rank of general on 21 October 1847.
